subject: Embedded SKU brokerage roadmap and co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita@consultly.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Sales <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embedded SKU proposal + quick POC ask

Hi Soojin,

Great catching up last week. As discussed, Consultly is proposing an embeddable SKU approach for our joint offering that would let customers license a small- footprint runtime + UI component bundled with their marketplace private offer. The core asks from our side:

- Ability to publish a clear SKU mapping for co-sell/private-offer flows (trial SKU, POC SKU, production SKU).
- Documentation on entitlements / reseller routing for private offers (billing mapping).
- A short mutual action plan so we can line up a joint POC with a lead next month.

I attached a preliminary SKU matrix (embedded-sku-matrix.xlsx) and a short draft of a margin split we typically use. We'd love Redwood to:

1) Confirm any gating requirements (monitoring/telemetry, support SLAs, demo credits).
2) Share the right technical contact to flesh in integration details (auth, telemetry, tenant isolation).
3) Suggest dates for a co-sell kickoff + internal enablement.

Proposed high-level kickoff window: week of Nov 4 (flexible).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

Best,
Anita Rao
VP, Partnerships | Consultly
www.consultly.io

Attachment: embedded-sku-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@consultly.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded SKU proposal + quick POC ask

Hi Anita — thanks for the matrix and the clear asks. Looping in Ben (channel/marketplace) and Vivek (co-sell ops) so we can align on commercial + enablement.

Quick responses to your three bullets:

- Gating: we'll need a short telemetry contract (basic runtime metrics + usage events) and completion of our co-sell evidence checklist (simple items: demo recording, sample listing copy, basic auth model). We can accept standard telemetry via your agent or our SDK; engineering will confirm.
- Technical contact: please work with engineering@consultly.io to connect with our platform team; Ben, Vivek — can you confirm the tech contact we should expect on the Redwood side?
- Kickoff window: Nov 4 week looks fine. For planning, can we aim to have the PoC scope and MOP (method of plan) agreed by Oct 24? I attached a first-pass roadmap (roadmap-draft.md) to seed the working session.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Ben/Vivek to confirm marketplace SKU mapping constraints and any private-offer billing caveats.
2) Exchange tech contacts and agree on integration checklist (auth, KV isolation, telemetry endpoints).
3) Schedule a 60m kickoff on Nov 5 or Nov 6; we can draft the PoC MOP before then.

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite with proposed times.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head, Alliances & Partner GTM | Redwood Inference

Attachment: roadmap-draft.md (text, 4KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <anita@consultly.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Oct 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded SKU proposal + quick POC ask

Thanks — quick notes from marketplace side:

- SKU mapping: marketplace listings require a trial SKU that is non-billable (metered trial), a POC SKU (timeboxed private offer), and a production SKU (standard metered listing). We'll share the exact naming constraints and entitlement flags by EOD (publishing rules differ slightly between AWS/Azure/GCP).
- Private-offer billing: for co-sell private offers we recommend mapping to a pre-authorized billing account; we can support credit routing but we'll need a signed MOU for any promotional credits.
- Credits & incentives: if Consultly wants promotional credits for joint demos, please put proposed amounts in the matrix and we can route to finance for pre-approval.

Technical contact on our side for integration: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com (works with runtime infra). Vivek — can you confirm acceptance of Consultly's telemetry agent or suggest Redwood SDK endpoints?

FYI: I'll prepare a short checklist we can attach to the PoC DocuSign (link to follow). Also adding a DocuSign placeholder for the MOU (https://www.docusign.com/embedded/ABC12345) — Anita, please review and we can loop legal if any custom terms are needed.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: co-sell-poc-mop.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

From: Anita Rao <anita@consultly.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Sales <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Oct 2029 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embedded SKU proposal + quick POC ask

On Wed, Oct 16, 2029 at 11:05 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — quick notes from marketplace side:
>
> - SKU mapping: marketplace listings require a trial SKU that is non-billable (metered trial), a POC SKU (timeboxed private offer), and a production SKU (standard metered listing). We'll share the exact naming constraints and entitlement flags by EOD (publishing rules differ slightly between AWS/Azure/GCP).

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clarity.

Anita here — quick updates from Consultly:
- We reviewed Redwood's proposed gating and we're comfortable with the telemetry contract; engineering@consultly.io will drop a short spec by Friday.
- We've filled out the SKU matrix with proposed demo credits and an initial revenue split for the POC: see updated embedded-sku-matrix.xlsx (attached).
- We reviewed the DocuSign placeholder and will route to our legal counsel; no blockers expected.

Next immediate asks:
1) Can Vivek confirm SDK endpoints and whether Redwood will accept off-host telemetry (we prefer to push events to Redwood ingest endpoint).
2) Ben — please share the marketplace SKU naming constraints for AWS and GCP in a single doc so our listing owner can prepare the listing copy.
3) I'll propose two kickoff slots: Nov 5, 10:00am PT or Nov 6, 9:00am PT — please pick one and we'll send an invite.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Anita Rao
VP, Partnerships | Consultly

Attachment: embedded-sku-matrix.xlsx (updated, 39KB)
